round1: Robin ran away with 32 points, including the only correct NYI in six, while Jamie managed just 4 for the second straight year. Marc was second with 23, and Benedict was the only one to nail Tampa in five.
round2: Nickall led the round with 18 points and was the only one to nail St. Louis in seven. Marc scored 2 and fell from second to sixth overall, while Robin kept the lead.
round3: Nathan nailed Pittsburgh in seven and San Jose in six for 24 points and jumped seven places. Derrick, Jake and Nickall all scored zero, and Stephanie took the overall lead.
round4: Jaclyn, Nickall and Stephanie nailed Pittsburgh in six for 15 each. Benedict, Derrick and Robin took San Jose in six for 5, and Nathan and Ryan took San Jose in five for nothing. Ryan has now had the lowest score in this round two years running.
overall: Stephanie won for the first time in her 18th year with 63 points, the highest winning total in pool history (previous best 61), after finishing 10th last year. She has now picked the right Cup winner three years in a row. Nickall was second with 51, and Jaclyn climbed from 9th after Round 1 to 4th. Derrick, second last year, finished last for the fifth time with 21; he, Benedict and Ryan have each picked the wrong Cup winner two years running.
